name: Aqua Mekong
waters: Mekong River and Tonle Sap, Cambodia and Vietnam

seo.title: Aqua Mekong: Luxury Mekong River Cruise | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Aqua Mekong by Aqua Expeditions: 20 suites, 40 guests, 40 crew. Three, four and seven nights between Ho Chi Minh City, Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, with every departure and fare.
keywords: Phnom Penh to Siem Reap cruise

tagline: Twenty suites, a 1:1 crew, and the Mekong from Ho Chi Minh City to the Tonle Sap.
answer: Aqua Mekong is Aqua Expeditions' 20-suite river ship on the Mekong. She carries 40 guests with 40 crew and sails three, four and seven nights between Ho Chi Minh City, Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, through Cambodia's villages and temples and Vietnam's delta, all year. She suits travellers who want culture by day and a five-star ship at night.
facts: 20 design suites of 30 sq m (322 sq ft); 644 sq ft interconnecting
Ho Chi Minh City, Phnom Penh and Siem Reap; 3, 4 or 7 nights
All year: high water mid-August to November, low water December to mid-August
overview: Aqua Mekong carries 40 guests in 20 design suites across three decks, with 40 crew: one for every guest, per Aqua Expeditions. Every suite is 30 sq m (322 sq ft) with a California king or twin beds; some have a balcony with a daybed, the others panoramic windows that open and a sofa that becomes a single bed, and pairs connect to make 644 sq ft.

On board are a plunge pool on the top deck, a spa, a gym, a private cinema, an indoor lounge and the dining room, and speedboats take guests ashore twice a day. The river decides the route: from mid-August to November the high water carries her up the Tonle Sap toward Siem Reap; from December to mid-August, in the low water, Siem Reap departures switch to Phnom Penh with a flight, which Aqua includes.

faqs: How much does an Aqua Mekong cruise cost?
Aqua lists three nights from about US$4,940 per person and seven nights from about US$11,800, depending on the deck and the date. Every departure's fare is in the table on this page.
Between Ho Chi Minh City (boarding at My Tho), Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, through the Mekong Delta in Vietnam and along the Mekong and Tonle Sap in Cambodia.
When is the best time for a Mekong cruise?

Any time: Aqua sails all year. High water, mid-August to November, lets the ship reach the Tonle Sap near Siem Reap; low water, December to mid-August, brings quieter rivers and cycling through the countryside.
How many guests does Aqua Mekong carry?
Can I combine Aqua Mekong with Angkor Wat?
Yes. Routes that start or end in Siem Reap sit beside the Angkor temples; ask us to add nights there.
All meals, selected wines and beer, two guided excursions a day, group transfers on Aqua's recommended flights, laundry, bicycles, kayaks and Starlink internet.
